title: Option Set
description: A non-binding sketch: several structurally different options for one brief, each with a status and a reason, plus a log of decisions. It is not a spec. It carries no gate and may hold open questions. Nothing here enters planning until a promote step turns the chosen option into a requirement.

title.description: What is being explored, in a few words

brief.description: The anchor brief. Re-read it at the start of every round so options do not drift from it.

problem.description: The problem or goal the options answer

audience.description: Who it serves, as a role or persona

constraints.description: Fixed facts the options must respect (brand, stack, tokens, content)

non_goals.description: What this exploration deliberately does not cover

direction.description: The committed overall direction (for design work, the aesthetic direction), once one is chosen

status.description: exploring while options are open; decided once an option is chosen; abandoned when the exploration is dropped

round.description: The current round of options within the chosen direction

options.description: Structurally different options. Three per round is the default; five is the cap.

id.description: Stable option identifier within the sketch (e.g. OPT-rail). Never reused for a different option.

summary.description: What this option is, in one or two sentences

structure.description: What makes this option structurally different from the others, not a variation of color or spacing

status.description: open while undecided; parked to revisit; chosen as the direction forward; rejected with a reason

reason.description: Why the option was parked, chosen or rejected. Required for every status except open.

assumptions.description: Assumptions the option makes that are not verified

open_questions.description: Unresolved questions. Allowed here; a spec may not carry them.

renders.description: Where the option can be seen

location.description: A workspace-relative path or a URL

theme.description: For example light, dark, or a brand name

decisions.description: The decision log. Append only; never rewrite an earlier entry.

fidelity.description: Marks the artifact as a non-binding sketch so nobody mistakes it for a spec
